svg.aria-label: A search with an AI answer
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: A search with an AI answer
svg.desc: The browser sends the query to the app server, which asks the bundled SearXNG instance for results, reranks them with a small cross-encoder, and returns them for the browser to cache. With AI responses on, the browser then has a model write a cited answer from the top results, either in the browser or through a remote backend.
